Immersive went mainstream on three fronts this week

Not one story, three. A studio filling venues across three continents, a Hollywood studio betting on domes, and an artist moving his life's work into the headset.

01 Field notes

Wevr filled venues on three continents

LA studio Wevr reported five location based experiences across Asia, Europe and South America reaching more than a million people this year, including The Blu: Expedition Taiwan, built with HTC VIVERSE and Taiwan's Ministry of Culture in Kaohsiung.

See the pattern ›
02
In the lab

Sony put 100 million dollars into domes

Sony is investing 100 million dollars in Cosm, the domed theater operator, which opens a fourth venue in Detroit this September and a fifth in Cleveland after that. The wraparound dome is spreading fast.

Follow the build ›
03 Craft

A named artist moved his catalog into spatial

A.R. Rahman launched ARR Immersive on Apple Vision Pro, bringing a decade of immersive storytelling into a spatial app. When artists of that scale port their work, brands get a lane to build inside it.
